zh: 港元活期存款高息招徠
work.en: Hong Kong banks are attracting customers with high-interest Hong Kong dollar savings accounts, offering rates of up to 6%. However, depositors should be aware that these accounts utilize a progressive interest rate structure.

The Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited, the Dubai Financial Services Authority, and Nasdaq Dubai have jointly established a Strategic Working Group. This initiative aims to strengthen financial ties and collaboration between Hong Kong and Dubai.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Haitian Flavouring Completes Acquisition of Amoy Food
smalltalk_hk.body: Chinese seasoning giant Haitian Flavouring has completed its acquisition of the century-old brand Amoy Food, with CITIC Capital selling its entire stake. The transaction value was not disclosed, but the move is aimed at boosting Haitian's expansion into overseas markets.

smalltalk_sg.headline: Syed Saddiq Invites Ong Ye Kung to October Wedding
smalltalk_sg.body: Malaysian politician Syed Saddiq Abdul Rahman has extended a wedding invitation to Singapore's Health Minister Ong Ye Kung for his upcoming nuptials in October. Saddiq lightheartedly joked that the gesture upgraded their bilateral relations to "wedding-invitation status."

personal_hk.headline: 沙田圍呂明才小學39人疑食物中毒 下周一起取消現場午膳分份
personal_hk.body:
浸信會沙田圍呂明才小學39名師生懷疑進食滷水雞髀和長通粉後食物中毒。
校方宣布下周一起暫停現場分份，全面改以獨立飯盒供應。

personal_sg.headline: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong Addresses Ministerial Salary Increases
personal_sg.body:
PM Lawrence Wong clarified that the recent salary increases are not about him or the PAP government, but are focused on Singapore's future.
He thanked Members of Parliament for participating in the discussion regarding the compensation adjustments.
